Silicon Carbide Heating Elements — Manufacturer & Supplier in India

High-temperature silicon carbide (SiC) heating elements in straight, U, W, spiral, dumbbell and Alpha SiC configurations — plus fully custom elements engineered to your furnace.

Overview

What are SiC heating elements?

Silicon carbide heating elements are electrical resistance heaters used in high-temperature electric furnaces. Current through the resistive hot zone produces radiant heat, while low-resistance cold ends carry current through the furnace wall. They're widely used in kilns, heat-treatment, laboratory, glass and metal-processing furnaces.

How they work: heat output follows P = V²/R. Resistance rises gradually with age, so furnaces use tap-changing or variable control to compensate.

FAQs

SiC heating element FAQs

What temperature can SiC heating elements reach?

SiC elements operate across a broad high-temperature range in air; the usable maximum depends on the grade, surface loading and furnace design. We confirm a suitable specification for your operating temperature.

Can you supply a replacement without a part number?

Yes. Send dimensions, a drawing or a photograph of your existing element and we'll identify a suitable replacement — see SiC heater replacement.

Do you make custom elements?

Yes — any diameter, length, hot/cold zone and terminal type, made to your drawing or an existing sample.

How are SiC elements priced?

Per configuration — price depends on geometry, grade and quantity. Request a quote with your details for accurate pricing.

Transparency: Available as manufactured or sourced/imported items depending on configuration — we confirm sourcing on every enquiry.
